story_scenes.title: Disko Bay Inflow & Polar Night
story_scenes.narration: Sunlight has vanished above the Arctic Circle. Warm Disko Bay water undercuts the fjord entrance while SAR maps the ice tongue cleanly in darkness.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Optical cameras are pitch black during polar winter—SAR + MODIS thermal temperature reveal full fjord dynamics.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Near-melting +2.5°C wet surface snow initially gives strong -11 dB scatter.

causal_chain.explanation: Warm Atlantic water melts submerged glacier base along the grounding line.

story_scenes.title: 1.2 km² Terminus Calving Event
story_scenes.narration: An enormous 1.2 km² wall calves off Jakobshavn in total polar darkness, tracked solely by Sentinel-1 / NISAR coherent backscatter.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Radar tracks iceberg edges through cloud & night while katabatic wind pushes brash ice seaward.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Steep 600 m gneiss fjord cliffs trigger radar layover shadow flags along northern margins.

causal_chain.explanation: Over-steepened ice cliff fractures into tabular icebergs.

story_scenes.title: Sub-Zero (-14°C) Freeze Illusion
story_scenes.narration: Air plunges to -14°C. Liquid moisture inside snow locks into ice crystals, dropping radar backscatter -8.5 dB even though ice hasn't melted!
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Temperature (<0°C) is mandatory to catch freeze-thaw dielectric drops in raw radar.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Freeze Illusion Guard ON: masks false-melt/false-drought drop caused by <0°C permittivity shift.

causal_chain.explanation: Frozen ice drops permittivity from ~80 (wet) to 3.1 (frozen), reducing SAR return.

story_scenes.title: 42 m/Day Glacier Surge
story_scenes.narration: With front ice pressure gone, the main glacier accelerates to 42 meters per day—creating jagged new crevasses clearly imaged by SAR.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Radar tracking + katabatic wind confirm rapid ice export toward Baffin Bay.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Freeze Guard remains engaged below 0°C to separate real crevasse breakup from cold dielectric dimming.

causal_chain.explanation: Unblocked glacier tongue slides faster into Ilulissat fjord.

story_scenes.title: Winter Sea-Ice Lock & Stabilization
story_scenes.narration: Deep -14°C cold consolidates floating brash ice into rigid winter fast-ice, temporarily locking the calving cliff until spring.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Persistent sub-zero thermal temperature + SAR structure confirm rigid fast-ice buttressing.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Winter multi-year ice settles into stable volume scatter.

causal_chain.explanation: Frozen melange bridges walls to resist fresh iceberg breakout.

illusion_summary: When temperatures plunge below 0°C, liquid meltwater inside snow freezes solid, collapsing radar dielectric constant from 80 to 3.1. Raw SAR plunges -8.5 dB—mimicking flooding or drought unless checked against <0°C thermal data.
causal_summary: Warm Subsurface Fjord Inflow -> Terminus Undercut & Calving -> 42 m/day Ice Surge in Polar Night -> Flash Freeze (-14°C) -> Dielectric SAR Drop Illusion (-8.5 dB).

geo_features.label: Iceberg Discharge & Katabatic Corridor
geo_features.detail: Calved icebergs & 12 m/s katabatic winds stream westward toward Baffin Bay.

geo_features.label: Jakobshavn Active Calving Terminus (42 m/day)
geo_features.detail: SAR pierces 24-hour polar darkness to track terminus retreat and crevasse slip.

geo_features.label: < 0°C Dielectric Freeze Illusion Zone
geo_features.detail: Temperature drops to -14°C, collapsing wet-snow permittivity & mimicking water loss unless MODIS LST corrects it.
